description: Add a new feature (trait, ability). Returns an error if a feature with that ID already exists.
name: addFeature

textId.description: English feature slug in kebab-case (rage, second-wind, dwarven-toughness). The canonical English identifier.

name.description: Localized feature name. If the language is Russian — write it in Russian. The English equivalent is already in textId; PARENTHESES () in this field are FORBIDDEN.

source.description: Source of the feature (class, race, background, etc.)

action.description: Action type, if the feature requires an action. Action type codes: Ac=ACTION, Bo=BONUS_ACTION, Re=REACTION, Mo=MOVEMENT, Fr=FREE, Le=LEGENDARY_ACTION, No=NONE (requires no action), Ot=OTHER.

type.description: Damage type. An object field {name, emoji?}. name — free text: "Fire", "Cold", "Piercing", "Lightning". emoji — one character: 🔥 for fire, ❄️ for cold, ⚡ for lightning, ☠️ for poison.

emoji.description: Emoji for the damage type (one character): 🔥 for fire, ❄️ for cold, ⚡ for lightning, ☠️ for poison, 🌑 for necrotic.

bonus.description: Damage bonus (for example, +2). THIS IS THE BONUS OF THE WEAPON ITSELF (+1 sword) OR THE SPELL'S BASE BONUS. DO NOT INCLUDE THE ABILITY MODIFIER HERE IF IT IS ALREADY IN THE ATTACK.

frequency.description: Usage frequency. Free text. Typical: "Short rest", "Long rest", "Once per turn", "Once per battle", "Once per day", "Once".

attribute.description: Ability for the saving throw. Ability codes: St=STRENGTH (strength), De=DEXTERITY (dexterity), Co=CONSTITUTION (constitution), In=INTELLIGENCE (intelligence), Wi=WISDOM (wisdom), Ch=CHARISMA (charisma).

effect.description: Effect on a successful saving throw

resource.description: Name of the consumed resource (if any), for example 'Ki Point'

resourceSymbol.description: Consumed resource symbol (1-2 characters or an emoji)

description: Record a new task for yourself as a result of self-review. Available ONLY in the SELF_REVIEW phase. After adding all tasks call transitionTo into the working phase — the frame will execute them there.
name: addTask

description.description: What exactly needs to be done

description: Mark the task as done. Use this tool after you have performed all the actions described in the task or fixed the problem found by the setter.
name: completeTask

reason.description: Optional: closing reason/comment. Required for "decision items" of the checklist (for example, refusing a book promotion): such an item is closed by a SEPARATE call with an explicit reason, not silently in a common batch.

description: Mark several tasks as done in one call. Use for going through the working phase's checklist in a row (for example, closing several 'chk-*' items) when there are no intermediate decisions between them. If an idea appears along the way — close them one by one via completeTask. REVIEW items ('rev-*', the self-check phase) are NOT closed by this tool: each requires a separate completeTask with a verdict-specific in reason, batch closing is rejected.
name: completeTasks

description: Delete the feature from the list by its ID.

description: Transition to another state (phase) of work. Call it once the current phase's work is complete — as the LAST call of the SAME response that finishes that work (when the phase rules allow the transition). The switch is applied at the END of this response: every other call in the same response still runs in the CURRENT phase, so it is safe to finish the phase's work and request the transition together. Do not spend a separate response on a lone transition call, and do not place new work AFTER the transition expecting the new phase.
name: transitionTo
